description: This file defines the Wishlist controller for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling wishlist-related functionalities such as viewing, adding, and removing products from the wishlist, and rendering relevant views.

classes.name: WishList
classes.description: Controller class for managing user wishlists in OpenCart, providing actions for displaying wishlist, adding, and removing products.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the wishlist page with breadcrumbs and loaded modules after verifying user login status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch the wishlist list, ensuring user is logged in.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the wishlist products list, including images, prices, stock status, and links, and renders the wishlist view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the wishlist, handling logged-in and guest users, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the wishlist for logged-in users, returning a JSON response.
